name: MaterialIdentifier
label: Material identifier
description: A unique proper name or character sequence that identifies this particular material. (NCIT:C93400)

name: CollectedFromPerson
label: Collected from person
description: Reference to the person from whom this material was collected. (SIO:000244)

name: BelongsToDiagnosis
label: Belongs to diagnosis
description: Reference to a diagnosis c.q. clinical examination of which this material may be a part of. There can be multiple diagnoses when a non-tumor material is reused as reference. (SIO:000068)

name: SamplingDate
label: Sampling date
description: The date that a sample was collected or obtained. (NCIT:C164024)

name: MaterialType
label: Material type
description: The broad biological nature of the collected substance prior to processing (e.g. whole blood, solid tissue, bone marrow, saliva, urine). (NCIT:C70713)

name: AnatomicalSource
label: Anatomical source
description: The specific organ, anatomical site, or bodily structure of the individual from which the biological material was procured. (NCIT:C13717)

name: PathologicalState
label: Pathological state
description: The histological or pathological condition of the procured biological specimen or biofluid (e.g. malignant, benign, non-involved control, premalignant). (NCIT:C28257)
